simple.meaning: מַהֲלַלְאֵל (Mahălalʼêl) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, 1 Chronicles, Nehemiah, beginning at Genesis 5:12. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, death.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מַהֲלַלְאֵל through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

structuredEvidence.definition: Mahalalel , the name of an antediluvian patriarch and of an Israelite

evidence: Lexicon or morphology identifies this as a proper name
Occurrence trail contains female relationship language

firstOccurrence.englishText: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.

timeline.evidenceText: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.
Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters
Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.
Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.

Some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin lived in Jerusalem. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;

definitions.full: H4111. Mahalalel מַהֲלַלְאֵל proper name, masculine **read מְהַלֶּלְאֵל Gray Prop. N. 201 . ( praise of God , compare יְהַלֶּלְאֵל above); — 1 great-grandson of Seth according to Genealogy of P, Gen 5:12-13 , 15 , 16 , 17 ; 1Chr 1:2 . 2 a man of Judah Neh 11:4 .
